patterns.note: The hero section features a full-bleed background image that scrolls underneath a fixed-position content block containing the main headline and call to action, creating a subtle parallax effect.
A prominent, continuously animating horizontal text ticker with benefit statements sticks to the viewport after the hero section, providing persistent, dynamic messaging as the user scrolls.
Primary headlines use an extremely bold and condensed sans-serif typeface, creating a high-impact, almost aggressive visual statement that dominates the page.
A vibrant, almost neon green is used consistently for primary call-to-action buttons and key accent elements, providing a strong contrast against the predominantly black and white palette.
Product display sections utilize a simple, clean grid layout with large, high-quality photography of the product cans, allowing the vibrant product colors to stand out.

technique_notes: The hero section is constructed with a large background image or video that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content block, giving the impression that the content slides over the background. A sticky header navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport.

A distinctive horizontal text ticker is implemented using CSS keyframes to animate its content continuously. This ticker is set to stick to a specific position in the viewport once it enters, ensuring its persistent visibility and motion as the user scrolls down the page.
A modal popup is triggered after a certain scroll depth, presenting a discount offer with an email capture form.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clear, legible standard sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to interactive elements like buttons and input fields, maintaining a clean yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, contrasted with a tighter grid for product displays.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the continuously animating, horizontally scrolling ticker that sticks to the viewport, providing a dynamic and persistent brand message. This, combined with the extremely bold, condensed typography and vibrant product photography, creates an energetic and memorable brand presence that feels both modern and assertive.
